name: RTI-274
summary: RTI(-4229)-274, or 2β-((3,4-Methylenedioxyphenoxy)methyl)-3α-(4-fluorophenyl)nortropane is a phenyltropane homologue of paroxetine developed by the group led by F Ivy Carroll in the 1990s.

uses.text: RTI(-4229)-274, or 2β-((3,4-Methylenedioxyphenoxy)methyl)-3α-(4-fluorophenyl)nortropane is a phenyltropane homologue of paroxetine developed by the group led by F Ivy Carroll in the 1990s.

pharmacology.en: It blocks the serotonin transporter, so serotonin stays longer in the gaps between nerve cells.
pharmacology.zh: 它會阻斷血清素轉運蛋白，使血清素在神經細胞之間停留更久。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会阻断血清素转运蛋白，使血清素在神经细胞之间停留更久。

fact.en: RTI-274 grafts part of the antidepressant paroxetine onto the tropane skeleton of cocaine, which turns it towards the serotonin transporter instead of dopamine.
fact.zh: RTI-274 把抗憂鬱藥帕羅西汀的一部分接到古柯鹼的托烷骨架上，使它轉而作用於血清素轉運蛋白而非多巴胺。
fact.zhHans: RTI-274 把抗忧郁药帕罗西汀的一部分接到古柯碱的托烷骨架上，使它转而作用于血清素转运蛋白而非多巴胺。
